exclusion_reason: Never calibrated -- skipped by the very first calibration run (2026-09-15/16) for insufficient paired S1/S2 imagery, cause not investigated until now. Root cause found 2026-09-22: FOL's AOI straddles two adjacent Sentinel-2 MGRS tiles (10SFH/10SFJ) close to 50/50, and find_new_scenes()/pair_s1_s2_dates() both require a single S2 scene to fully contain the AOI -- so almost no S2 scene ever qualifies (1 of 347 candidates over a 2-year window). This is a real Stage 1 gap (not calibration-only): FOL has had essentially no usable optical measurements since the pipeline's inception. SAR (S1) coverage is unaffected (122/398 scenes cover the AOI, normal fraction) since S1's wider swath tolerates the tile-adjacent geometry better. A fleet-wide check (2026-09-22) found 27/48 reservoirs span 2+ S2 tiles but all others get normal S2 pair counts (60-240 over 2 years) -- FOL is an isolated geometric outlier, not a widespread defect, so a proper fix (teaching Stage 1 to mosaic same-date S2 tiles before the coverage check) was deferred to a dedicated future session rather than built for this one reservoir alone. Excluded until that fix exists.

SAR/optical disagreement (validation error 158%, worst in fleet) traced to the optical/Dynamic-World calibration target itself, not SAR: narrow steep-walled canyon causes terrain shadow contamination of NDWI and likely Dynamic World too (2026-09-14/17 smoke test findings). Both S1 geometries show consistent bias in the same direction -- not a fixable orbit defect. AOI/shape diagnosis clean (2026-09-21), so recalibrating SAR against a broken reference would not help.
